finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 10; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A reservation unconsumed at the lapse point, held past it.
why: Section 12.5 row 10, R-X24 and AD-022: a reserve under a non-rolling allowance is waste rather than thrift. The mutation deletes the independence-of-consent conjunct, leaving the lapse point declared and the lapsed quantity recorded -- an accounting of a lapse that cannot happen without the holder agreeing to it.
